notes.title: Liminal Exit Demo Patch #3
notes.content:
Polish and patch:
[list]
[*] Sprint left and support added.
[*] Anomaly P2 - The door have some gaps in it when its closed.
[*] Camera shake added then near the monster sound.
[*] The lost TV noise added

[/list]

Fixes:

[*] Sound minor fixes.
[*] Blackhole transition delay fixed.
[/list]
